description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans hosted client functionality, including grain invocation, timeout handling, reference equality, observer pattern, and streaming, within a test suite using Xunit.

classes.name: HostedClientTests
classes.description: Test suite for Orleans hosted client features, including grain calls, timeouts, object references, observers, and streams.

classes.name: HostedClientTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up and tearing down Orleans test cluster environment.

methods.name: HostedClient_GrainCallTest
methods.description: Tests basic in-process grain invocation and verifies the returned value.

methods.name: HostedClient_TimeoutTest
methods.description: Verifies timeout behavior and request tracking during unresponsive grain scenarios.

methods.name: HostedClient_ReferenceEquality_GrainCallTest
methods.description: Checks reference equality semantics for immutable, mutable, and wrapped objects passed through grains.

methods.name: HostedClient_ObserverTest
methods.description: Tests client registration of observer objects and callback invocation.

methods.name: HostedClient_StreamTest
methods.description: Verifies streaming subscription and message reception from Orleans streams.
